item.title: Eagles’ 28-Year-Old Pro Bowler Gets Trade Market Update
item.description: PHILADELPHIA, PENNSYLVANIA - OCTOBER 16: Philadelphia Eagles General Manager Howie Roseman looks on prior to the game between the Philadelphia Eagles and the Dallas Cowboys at Lincoln Financial Field on October 16, 2022 in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. (Photo by Mitchell Leff/Getty Images) Getty PHILADELPHIA, PA - JULY 28: Landon Dickerson #51 of the Philadelphia Eagles looks on during training camp at the NovaCare Complex on July 28, 2021 in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. (Photo by Mitchell Leff/Getty Images) Getty INGLEWOOD, CALIFORNIA - OCTOBER 08: Landon Dickerson #69 of the Philadelphia Eagles celebrates after scoring a touchdown in the second quarter against the Los Angeles Rams at SoFi Stadium on October 08, 2023 in Inglewood, California. (Photo by Harry How/Getty Images) Getty EAST RUTHERFORD, NEW JERSEY - OCTOBER 15: Jason Kelce #62 and Landon Dickerson #69 of the Philadelphia Eagles warms up before the game against the New York Jets at MetLife Stadium on October 15, 2023 in East Rutherford, New Jersey. (Photo by Dustin Satloff/Getty Images) Getty Over the next week, the Philadelphia Eagles have a big decision to make surrounding the veteran guard, Landon Dickerson. While the offensive lineman made his thoughts on his future clear, the Eagles might be feeling a different way. “It’s something you really can’t focus on and worry about. I love this city it’s my home. I spend my offseasons here. I love my teammates, coaches, I love everybody, and I really don’t want to play for another team. But at the same time, that’s not a decision that you can make as a player,” Dickerson said on 94WIP. Getty PHILADELPHIA, PA – JULY 28: Landon Dickerson #51 of the Philadelphia Eagles looks on during training camp at the NovaCare Complex on July 28, 2021 in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. (Photo by Mitchell Leff/Getty Images) It’s unclear just how motivated the Eagles are to move Dickerson, but a new report suggests that he has an active market with multiple unnamed suitors. Eagles’ 28-Year-Old Pro Bowler Gets Trade Market Update Getty INGLEWOOD, CALIFORNIA – OCTOBER 08: Landon Dickerson #69 of the Philadelphia Eagles celebrates after scoring a touchdown in the second quarter against the Los Angeles Rams at SoFi Stadium on October 08, 2023 in Inglewood, California. (Photo by Harry How/Getty Images) “Landon Dickerson continues to draw interest from teams looking for help up front, per source,” NBC Sports Philadelphia’s Ryan Fowler reported on Wednesday, November 4. “Much of the focus surrounding the Eagles has been on potential moves involving names like Riq Woolen and Moro Ojomo, and while they could also be moved, conversations over the last few days suggest multiple teams have expressed interest in acquiring the veteran guard.” Getty EAST RUTHERFORD, NEW JERSEY – OCTOBER 15: Jason Kelce #62 and Landon Dickerson #69 of the Philadelphia Eagles warms up before the game against the New York Jets at MetLife Stadium on October 15, 2023 in East Rutherford, New Jersey.

(Photo by Harry How/Getty Images) “Landon Dickerson continues to draw interest from teams looking for help up front, per source,” NBC Sports Philadelphia’s Ryan Fowler reported on Wednesday, November 4. “Much of the focus surrounding the Eagles has been on potential moves involving names like Riq Woolen and Moro Ojomo, and while they could also be moved, conversations over the last few days suggest multiple teams have expressed interest in acquiring the veteran guard.” Getty EAST RUTHERFORD, NEW JERSEY – OCTOBER 15: Jason Kelce #62 and Landon Dickerson #69 of the Philadelphia Eagles warms up before the game against the New York Jets at MetLife Stadium on October 15, 2023 in East Rutherford, New Jersey. (Photo by Dustin Satloff/Getty Images) All signs are pointing to Dickerson being the candidate who is most likely to get moved. As injuries have piled up for the veteran guard over the past year, the Eagles have struggled to find consistency up front. They already experienced major changes this year. Cam Jurgens was traded to the Baltimore Ravens . Lane Johnson decided to retire. With the Eagles sitting at 2-6 with an uncertain future in other areas on the offensive side of the ball, Dickerson just might find himself getting a change as well. While the 28-year-old three-time Pro Bowler isn’t actively forcing his way out, teams might come up with an offer good enough to get Howie Roseman to strike a deal. item.title: VMware releases vSphere Express for virtualization on up to 128 cores
item.description: After alienating many long-time small- to medium-sized business (SMB) customers, Broadcom’s VMware is trying to appeal to its smaller customers. Today, the virtualization company announced vSphere Express, a lower-end virtualization offering for organizations that require “cost-effective essential virtualization.” vSphere Express comes after many customers reported that VMware was pushing them to VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), the flagship private cloud bundle that has many features SMBs don’t need and is expensive. Some SMB users have reported that VMware sales representatives previously told them that vSphere Standard, VMware's prior entry-level virtualization offering, wasn’t available anymore. Read full article Comments

item.title: VIDEO: Makinde Unveils Manifesto, Faults Nigerian Leaders For Lack Of Ideas
item.description: The presidential candidate of the Allied Peoples Movement (APM), Seyi Makinde, has blamed Nigeria’s development challenges on a lack of ideas among its leaders, despite the country’s vast natural and human resources. Makinde made the remarks on Wednesday in Abuja during the unveiling of his manifesto for the 2027 general elections. The Oyo State Governor said the document outlines his proposed solutions to the country’s economic, political, social and institutional challenges. He explained that the manifesto was drawn up after extensive consultations with Nigerians across the six geopolitical zones, including town hall meetings where participants shared their expectations for the country. item.title: AMD's record quarter: Data center business doubles, while gaming craters
item.description: AMD reported third-quarter revenues on Tuesday with a record $13.4 billion, an increase of 45 percent year over year, as data center business nearly doubled and the company's gaming segment cratered. AMD CFO Jean Hu said, "We expect revenue to be approximately $17 billion, plus or minus 3%. The middle point of our guidance represents approximately 66% year-over-year revenue growth, primarily driven by the acceleration of our Data Center segment." AMD says its Q4 revenue projections are up another 27 percent from this quarter's results. As reported by Tom's Hardware , Intel's Q4 guidance places revenue estimates between $15 and $16 billion. That means that if both companies land where they expect to at the end of the fourth quarter, AMD would exceed Intel's revenue for the first time in history. The data center segment of AMD's business was up 97 percent year over year, with a record $8.5 billion. AMD attributes the growth to demand for its EPYC line of enterprise server CPUs, along with the launch of the Instinct MI450 series GPUs . Sales of AMD Ryzen mobile chips led growth in the Client business, which includes desktop Ryzen processors and posted $2.95 billion in revenue, up 7 percent year over year. Read full article Comments

item.title: Kekere-Ekun to chair presentation of Pinheiro’s 6 legal publications
item.description: By Innocent Anaba The Chief Justice of Nigeria, CJN, Justice Kudirat Kekere-Ekun, will chair the public presentation of six legal books authored by Dr ‘Kemi Pinheiro, SAN, on November 20, 2026. The publications, which draw on Pinheiro’s nearly four decades of legal practice, examine critical areas of Nigerian law, including criminal litigation, arbitration, corporate insolvency, justice administration and emerging legal issues. The collection comprises Strategies in Criminal Trial: A Practitioner’s Guide; Insolvency Law in Nigeria: Practice and Procedure; Arbitration Law and Practice in Nigeria; Defining Moments: Chronicles of a Silk (Volume One); The Compendium; and MULAN Legal: Trending Issues of Law and Faith – Essays in Honour of ‘Kemi Pinheiro, SAN. The book on criminal trials examines key procedural and evidential issues in criminal proceedings, including the treatment and admissibility of electronic evidence. Similarly, Insolvency Law in Nigeria: Practice and Procedure explores the legal framework governing corporate rescue, restructuring and insolvency proceedings under the Companies and Allied Matters Act 2020. Arbitration Law and Practice in Nigeria examines the country’s arbitration framework, with particular attention to the Arbitration and Mediation Act 2023 and the enforcement of arbitral awards. It also addresses the growing importance of alternative dispute resolution in settling commercial disputes. Beyond these practice-oriented publications, Defining Moments: Chronicles of a Silk (Volume One) chronicles Pinheiro’s professional journey and experiences in the legal profession. The Compendium features scholarly essays by legal practitioners and academics, while MULAN Legal: Trending Issues of Law and Faith – Essays in Honour of ‘Kemi Pinheiro, SAN examines the intersection of law, faith and Nigeria’s plural legal system through contributions from various authors. The six publications bring together practical legal guidance, academic research and professional reflections on the development of Nigerian law, with subject matter relevant to judges, legal practitioners, academics and other stakeholders in the administration of justice. The public presentation, organised by Pinheiro LP, is expected to attract members of the judiciary, the Bar, academia and other stakeholders in the legal profession. The post Kekere-Ekun to chair presentation of Pinheiro’s 6 legal publications appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Bose’s QuietComfort Headphones are more than half off
item.description: It’s not often that some of the best noise-canceling headphones you can buy are over half off. But right now, the first-gen Bose QuietComfort Headphones are on sale for $169.99 ($190 off) at Amazon , Best Buy , and Bose , matching its best price to date. The newer, second-generation version that launched in August is also down to $199 ($160 off) in multiple colors at Amazon , Best Buy , and directly from Bose , which is just $20 shy of the all-time low price. Bose QuietComfort Headphones Where to Buy: $359 $169 at Amazon $359 $169 at Best Buy $359 $169 at Bose Bose QuietComfort Headphones Gen 2 Where to Buy: $359 $199 at Amazon $359 $199 at Best Buy $359 $199 at Bose While Bose’s original QuietComfort Headphones are no longer the latest model, they’re still a solid option for anyone seeking effective noise cancellation, good sound, and 24-hour battery life without spending a fortune. They also support multipoint Bluetooth connectivity, so you can connect to two devices simultaneously, and they feature a lightweight, foldable design that makes them easy to pack. The second-generation QuietComfort Headphones build on that foundation with a few worthwhile upgrades for $30 more. Of note, our reviewer John Higgins considers their default sound profile to be the best he’s heard from Bose, even better than the flagship $449 QuietComfort Ultra Gen 2. They also support lossless audio via USB-C. While he thought that vocals sounded a bit muted, he was able to fix the issue by tweaking the three-band equalizer in Bose’s companion app. Higgins also considers the QuietComfort Headphones more comfortable than the Ultra thanks to their lack of “ eardrum suck ,” the unpleasant sensation of ear pressure from a strong active noise cancellation effect. Read our Bose QuietComfort Headphones (second-generation) review.

item.title: Valverde strike snatches Real Madrid late win at AEK Athens
item.description: Federico Valverde lashed home a stunning effort from distance to snatch Real Madrid a late 3-2 victory at AEK Athens on Wednesday in the Champions League and preserve their 100 percent start. Jose Mourinho’s side twice came from behind against the Greek champions before Valverde claimed all three points for his side, level with holders Paris Saint-Germain on four wins from four league phase games. Aboubakary Koita sent AEK ahead after 12 minutes and Jude Bellingham equalised with a sublime flick for the record 15-time winners. Stavros Pilios sent the Greek champions ahead with 15 minutes to go but Kylian Mbappe swiftly pulled Madrid level once again, setting the stage for Valverde’s late winner. “Fede has that capability… (but) I didn’t ask him to shoot,” Mourinho told Movistar about his match-winner, who came on in the second half. “I told him was that the game was wide open, it was being played at great speed… a fresh player like Fede, with his ability to cover a lot of ground, I told him to attack the space and arrive in the dangerous areas.” Madrid have now won seven straight games across all competitions. “We fought for (the victory), and with the score at 2–2 we didn’t settle,” added Mourinho. “It would always be an acceptable result, we’d be on 10 points, but we wanted more.” Mourinho started with Vinicius Junior on the left flank, after he missed the team’s previous two matches through suspension, in La Liga. The hosts started with huge energy at the Agia Sophia stadium and it was not overly surprising when they took an early lead. Real Madrid goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois saved well from former Los Blancos striker Luka Jovic before Koita sent AEK ahead. The Mauritanian winger shifted cleverly inside Marc Cucurella and thumped home at the near post, catching out Courtois. The Belgian goalkeeper saved again from Jovic as AEK tried to make their strong start count. However they inevitably began to tire and Madrid began to take the reins in the Greek capital. Kylian Mbappe fired over and Bellingham netted from close range but was shown to be offside. Moments later the England international scored again and nobody could deny him this one. Cucurella fired in a low cross and Bellingham produced a brilliant flicked finish to beat goalkeeper Alberto Brignoli. Former Chelsea defender Cucurella tested Brignoli and Bernardo Silva nodded off-target before the interval as Mourinho’s team controlled the game. Brignoli pushed away Eder Militao’s long-range effort early in the second half and Lazaros Rota blocked superbly to deny the heavily-involved Cucurella. – Another fightback – Mbappe bent a shot narrowly wide of the top corner with Italian stopper Brignoli at full stretch. The France forward was frustrated by the AEK defence when Vinicius turned sharply and found him with a high pass, but the striker’s shot was blocked. item.content:encoded: Federico Valverde lashed home a stunning effort from distance to snatch Real Madrid a late 3-2 victory at AEK Athens on Wednesday in the Champions League and preserve their 100 percent start. Jose Mourinho’s side twice came from behind against the Greek champions before Valverde claimed all three points for his side, level with holders Paris Saint-Germain on four wins from four league phase games. Aboubakary Koita sent AEK ahead after 12 minutes and Jude Bellingham equalised with a sublime flick for the record 15-time winners. Stavros Pilios sent the Greek champions ahead with 15 minutes to go but Kylian Mbappe swiftly pulled Madrid level once again, setting the stage for Valverde’s late winner. “Fede has that capability… (but) I didn’t ask him to shoot,” Mourinho told Movistar about his match-winner, who came on in the second half. “I told him was that the game was wide open, it was being played at great speed… a fresh player like Fede, with his ability to cover a lot of ground, I told him to attack the space and arrive in the dangerous areas.” Madrid have now won seven straight games across all competitions. “We fought for (the victory), and with the score at 2–2 we didn’t settle,” added Mourinho. “It would always be an acceptable result, we’d be on 10 points, but we wanted more.” Mourinho started with Vinicius Junior on the left flank, after he missed the team’s previous two matches through suspension, in La Liga. The hosts started with huge energy at the Agia Sophia stadium and it was not overly surprising when they took an early lead. Real Madrid goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois saved well from former Los Blancos striker Luka Jovic before Koita sent AEK ahead. The Mauritanian winger shifted cleverly inside Marc Cucurella and thumped home at the near post, catching out Courtois. The Belgian goalkeeper saved again from Jovic as AEK tried to make their strong start count. However they inevitably began to tire and Madrid began to take the reins in the Greek capital. Kylian Mbappe fired over and Bellingham netted from close range but was shown to be offside. Moments later the England international scored again and nobody could deny him this one. Cucurella fired in a low cross and Bellingham produced a brilliant flicked finish to beat goalkeeper Alberto Brignoli. Former Chelsea defender Cucurella tested Brignoli and Bernardo Silva nodded off-target before the interval as Mourinho’s team controlled the game. Brignoli pushed away Eder Militao’s long-range effort early in the second half and Lazaros Rota blocked superbly to deny the heavily-involved Cucurella. – Another fightback – Mbappe bent a shot narrowly wide of the top corner with Italian stopper Brignoli at full stretch. The France forward was frustrated by the AEK defence when Vinicius turned sharply and found him with a high pass, but the striker’s shot was blocked. AEK reclaimed the lead in the 75th minute when the impressive Koita gently nudged the ball into Pilios’s path and the Albania international finished through Courtois’s legs from close range. Madrid immediately responded with Bellingham playing Denzel Dumfries in down the right. The Netherlands defender rolled a low ball across the six-yard box and this time Mbappe was able to finish. It was Mbappe’s fourth goal in four Champions League games this season, netting once in each, and his 16th across all competitions. Madrid substitute Endrick sent Mbappe through on goal with five minutes remaining but Brignoli produced a sensational save to tip his strike against the crossbar. Valverde refused to give up on the three points and in the 92nd minute he lashed home across Brignoli to keep Madrid perfect. Koita, who had been substituted, was sent off after the game for apparent dissent. Valverde thanked his team-mates for backing him when he gets the chance to shoot. “Sometimes I overthink it, and well, as I always say, I’m grateful to the players, to my teammates, because they’re the ones who give me the confidence so that, in those moments, I can make that decision and have the courage to hit it,” he said. item.title: VIDEO: Tinubu, Atiku Are Old, They Should Allow Younger Ones To Lead – Oyinlola
item.description: Former Osun State Governor Olagunsoye Oyinlola has said President Bola Tinubu and former Vice President Atiku Abubakar should retire from active politics and allow younger Nigerians to take over the country’s leadership. Oyinlola, a member of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP), said he supports Oyo State Governor Seyi Makinde, who is seeking the presidency on the platform of the Allied Peoples Movement (APM), for the 2027 election. Speaking on Channels Television’s Politics Today on Wednesday, the former governor argued that age should be a consideration in determining who seeks public office. “When I was in Osun, I made a declaration based on my experience in office that anybody above 50 should not aspire to be governor of a state,” Oyinlola said. He maintained that Tinubu and Atiku should step aside to give younger elements an opportunity to lead Nigeria. ﻿ The post VIDEO: Tinubu, Atiku Are Old, They Should Allow Younger Ones To Lead – Oyinlola appeared first on Channels Television .

item.title: Musk-backed candidates lose midterms despite financial backing
item.description: Shares of Tesla and SpaceX dropped after the Democratic party swept to power in America's midterm elections. Their founder, tech titan Elon Musk, poured over $440 million into Republican candidates and causes, the single biggest campaign donor in the election cycle. But his investment fell flat, as his preferred candidates lost races in Texas, where he has put down roots.

item.title: NASA Shares Plans to Accelerate Artemis, Return to Moon
item.description: 4 min read Preparations for Next Moonwalk Simulations Underway (and Underwater) In an update on Oct. 23, NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman and other agency leaders shared the agency’s path to returning Americans to the lunar surface in 2028. Agency leadership provided updates on the previously announced acceleration plans for the Artemis program, advancing toward the agency’s Artemis III test flight in 2027 and Artemis IV Moon landing mission in 2028. Building on the priorities announced at Ignition earlier this year, NASA leadership shared the agency’s significant progress across its missions, working with industry partners to test critical capabilities, reduce risk, and build toward a sustained American presence on the Moon. This graphic shows NASA’s concept of operations for Artemis III. The mission will send four astronauts to low Earth orbit next year to test critical systems needed for future lunar landings. NASA “This is a very energized NASA, and these updates are only a small part of that story. We are bringing extreme focus to the mission to ensure delivery of world-changing outcomes as quickly, safely, affordably, and successfully as possible,” said Isaacman. “NASA is driving outcomes to make Moon missions a reality, and we’re not waiting for others to bring their plans to us — the campaign must move with urgency as strategic competitors pursue a permanent presence beyond Earth.” The agency shared details of the Artemis III mission, which will test rendezvous, docking, and operations between NASA’s Orion spacecraft and lunar lander test vehicles from SpaceX and Blue Origin in Earth orbit. Four astronauts will fly aboard Orion, launched on NASA’s SLS (Space Launch System) rocket, for a planned 14-day mission in Earth orbit to reduce risk ahead of the Artemis IV moon landing mission. The Artemis III mission will unfold in sequence: Blue Origin will launch a Blue Moon lander test article into Earth orbit, SLS will launch Orion and its crew, docking with the Blue Moon lander test article, then SpaceX will launch a Version 3 Starship lander test article while Orion will undock from Blue Moon and dock with Starship. The Oct. 23 updates follow other recent updates about the Artemis missions. Hardware for Artemis III is on track, with processing timelines sharply reduced by about half. NASA also redesigned, built, and tested a critical fuel-line component in-house in five months, at roughly a tenth of the cost of an earlier outside-vendor estimate. “NASA should be expected to do this kind of work, and we have some of the best technical knowledge in the world on rocket hardware and operations to do it,” said Jeremy Parsons, the agency’s Artemis program manager. “It’s an example of how we are rebuilding our core competencies and developing centers of excellence in technical functions instead of continuing to outsource expertise.” Artemis IV: Pursuing multiple paths to Moon landing For the agency’s Artemis IV mission in 2028, astronauts will laun

NASA also redesigned, built, and tested a critical fuel-line component in-house in five months, at roughly a tenth of the cost of an earlier outside-vendor estimate. “NASA should be expected to do this kind of work, and we have some of the best technical knowledge in the world on rocket hardware and operations to do it,” said Jeremy Parsons, the agency’s Artemis program manager. “It’s an example of how we are rebuilding our core competencies and developing centers of excellence in technical functions instead of continuing to outsource expertise.” Artemis IV: Pursuing multiple paths to Moon landing For the agency’s Artemis IV mission in 2028, astronauts will launch aboard Orion on the SLS rocket from NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida. NASA is working with SpaceX and Blue Origin to develop lunar landers to carry those astronauts to the Moon’s surface. Both companies have redesigned their approaches to simplify the missions and make them more efficient and flexible as compared to previous mission designs. SpaceX’s Starship will refuel in Earth orbit, rendezvous with Orion, and then carry the spacecraft toward the Moon. Blue Origin’s approach involves transfer stages in Earth orbit to push its Blue Moon Mark 2 lander toward the Moon, where it will meet Orion in a closer lunar orbit before descending to the surface. NASA NASA Both SpaceX and Blue Origin are targeting to be able to support a crewed lunar landing in 2028. For Artemis IV, NASA is pursuing two upper-stage options for the SLS rocket: its current stage, the interim cryogenic propulsion stage; and a stretched version of ULA’s Centaur V which can carry more propellant. Pursuing both options ensures NASA is maintaining flexibility and preventing single-point dependency. NASA also announced plans with spacesuit provider Axiom Space to develop a second, lighter suit design called the “Sortie suit” to enable the first moonwalks. The Sortie suit will not replace Axiom’s primary suit, which will be used for longer, more demanding missions in the future. The Sortie suit is roughly half the weight of the larger suit and lets NASA move faster on the earliest surface missions. As part of a Golden Age of innovation and exploration, NASA will send Artemis astronauts on increasingly difficult missions at the lunar South Pole to explore more of the Moon than ever before. In addition to providing economic benefits and advancing scientific discovery through its Moon missions, NASA will establish an enduring human presence on the lunar surface and build on the agency’s foundation for the first crewed mission to Mars. item.title: New D&D Book Introduces Some of the Most Terrifying Boss Fights in the Game’s History
item.description: Vecna is arguably the archetypical "boss character" in Dungeons & Dragons . For almost 40 years now, Vecna's machinations have endangered D&D's multiverse, only to be opposed and defeated but never permanently destroyed by groups of outmatched adventurers. In his last outing, Vecna: Eve of Ruin , Vecna is designed to be a unique threat who's capable of winning against a party of 20th-level adventurers. On Azeroth, however, he'd just be another face in the crowd.

item.title: Upcoming Marvel movies and TV shows: Avengers: Doomsday, Secret Wars, X-Men & more
item.description: Marvel fatigue? Think again, especially after Spider-Man: Brand New Day made over $2.5 billion worldwide and Avengers: Doomsday is looking hot, hot, hot! But even after the uneven Multiverse Saga ends (hopefully on a high note), Marvel Studios won’t be stopping. So, we've put together a list of all the upcoming MCU movies and shows confirmed so far. While the MCU isn't stopping, Marvel has slowed its roll, with the powers that be returning to the “quality over quantity” approach that defined Marvel Studios’ Infinity Saga output. This means no more than three movies per year and, perhaps more importantly, severely cutting down on TV productions, with a focus on multi-season shows rather than limited series that should’ve been a movie. It’s a time of change for both Disney and Marvel, but it seems everyone agrees the big screen reigns supreme, so expect a thinner streaming output and more relevant movies starring characters you actually know. More will be revealed in due time, but for now, here’s what lies at the Multiverse Saga’s end and beyond... Spoilers ahead for the Marvel Cinematic Universe so far. Watch Marvel movies and shows on Disney+: Disney+ (With Ads): $11.99/month Disney+ Premium (No Ads): $18.99/month or $189.99/year Avengers: Doomsday — December 18, 2026 (Image credit: Marvel Studios) Release date: December 18, 2026 | Director: Anthony & Joe Russo | Cast: Chris Hemsworth, Chris Evans, Pedro Pascal, Robert Downey Jr. Earth’s Mightiest Heroes (from different Earths, actually) are assembling again in December 2026. Avengers: Doomsday 's cast looks ridiculously stacked, and it’ll finally realize the dream of bringing together the Avengers, the Fantastic Four, and the X-Men (Fox’s original ones, that is) on the big screen. It’s a lot to absorb, and we don’t really know what's going on, but the trailers released so far are promising. Anthony & Joe Russo (Captain America: The Winter Soldier & Civil War, Avengers: Infinity War & Endgame) are returning to direct, so that’s a good reason to be hyped even if the duo’s post-Marvel career hasn’t been the most exciting. Stephen McFeely (one of their two go-to scribes) is also back, and Michael Waldron ( Loki ) is helping out as well. It’s an all-star team for the most ambitious MCU project to date, at least until it all culminates in... Hopefully, that energy will continue in the third and final outing , as the Defenders reunite, with Finn Jones, Krysten Ritter, and Mike Colter all returning from their Netflix shows. Another shocker is the (unofficially) confirmed return of Elodie Yung’s Elektra. We suspect some of these characters will be transferred to movies post-Secre
item.dc:creator: Fran Ruiz
item.content:encoded: Marvel fatigue? Think again, especially after Spider-Man: Brand New Day made over $2.5 billion worldwide and Avengers: Doomsday is looking hot, hot, hot! But even after the uneven Multiverse Saga ends (hopefully on a high note), Marvel Studios won’t be stopping. So, we've put together a list of all the upcoming MCU movies and shows confirmed so far. While the MCU isn't stopping, Marvel has slowed its roll, with the powers that be returning to the “quality over quantity” approach that defined Marvel Studios’ Infinity Saga output. This means no more than three movies per year and, perhaps more importantly, severely cutting down on TV productions, with a focus on multi-season shows rather than limited series that should’ve been a movie. It’s a time of change for both Disney and Marvel, but it seems everyone agrees the big screen reigns supreme, so expect a thinner streaming output and more relevant movies starring characters you actually know. More will be revealed in due time, but for now, here’s what lies at the Multiverse Saga’s end and beyond... Spoilers ahead for the Marvel Cinematic Universe so far. Watch Marvel movies and shows on Disney+: Disney+ (With Ads): $11.99/month Disney+ Premium (No Ads): $18.99/month or $189.99/year Avengers: Doomsday — December 18, 2026 (Image credit: Marvel Studios) Release date: December 18, 2026 | Director: Anthony & Joe Russo | Cast: Chris Hemsworth, Chris Evans, Pedro Pascal, Robert Downey Jr. Earth’s Mightiest Heroes (from different Earths, actually) are assembling again in December 2026. Avengers: Doomsday 's cast looks ridiculously stacked, and it’ll finally realize the dream of bringing together the Avengers, the Fantastic Four, and the X-Men (Fox’s original ones, that is) on the big screen. It’s a lot to absorb, and we don’t really know what's going on, but the trailers released so far are promising. Anthony & Joe Russo (Captain America: The Winter Soldier & Civil War, Avengers: Infinity War & Endgame) are returning to direct, so that’s a good reason to be hyped even if the duo’s post-Marvel career hasn’t been the most exciting. Stephen McFeely (one of their two go-to scribes) is also back, and Michael Waldron ( Loki ) is helping out as well. It’s an all-star team for the most ambitious MCU project to date, at least until it all culminates in... Daredevil: Born Again (Season 3) — March 2027 (Image credit: Marvel Studios) Release window: March 2027 | Showrunner: Dario Scardapane | Cast: Charlie Cox, Mike Colter, Finn Jones, Krysten Ritter Daredevil: Born Again’s debut season was far from perfect, but most viewers agreed that Season 2 was a marked improvement. Hopefully, that energy will continue in the third and final outing , as the Defenders reunite, with Finn Jones, Krysten Ritter, and Mike Colter all returning from their Netflix shows. Another shocker is the (unofficially) confirmed return of Elodie Yung’s Elektra. We suspect some of these characters will be transferred to movies post-Secret Wars. In any case, Born Again’s final season should be packed, especially if Marvel Television is sticking to eight or nine episodes. Avengers: Secret Wars — December 17, 2027 (Image credit: Marvel Studios) Release date: December 17, 2027 | Director: Anthony & Joe Russo | Cast: Chris Hemsworth, Chris Evans, Pedro Pascal, Robert Downey Jr. Practically nothing about the follow-up to Avengers: Doomsday has been revealed yet (though we assume the MCU’s main players will be part of the ensemble), but we know it fully starts shooting in late 2026 and is eyeing a Christmas 2027 arrival. The plan is to leave a year-long wait between the two event movies, leaving fans hanging like back in the MCU’s glory days. The title comes from Jonathan Hickman’s Secret Wars (2015) , which is probably the main source of inspiration for the upcoming big-screen event. Incursions (realities bleeding into each other) have already been set up during the Multiverse Saga, and we know Doomsday directly deals with the multiverse’s breaking point, so it’s easy to see where the larger picture is going. No spoilers here, but prepare for a very different kind of Avengers flick if Battleworld is indeed the main setting. Untitled X-Men film — May 5, 2028 (Image credit: Marvel Studios) Release date: May 5, 2028 | Director: Jake Schreier | Cast: Kit Connor, Sadie Sink, Adam Driver, Christopher Abbott Whatever happens in Secret Wars (we’ve heard Marvel Studios intends to soft-reboot ), Phase Seven of the MCU will kick off with a long-awaited, fresh take on the X-Men — now part of the larger Marvel universe housing all characters. Thunderbolts* director Jake Schreier will be directing, with the same writing team from that movie joining him for another Marvel adventure. Spider-Man: Brand New Day already did some heavy lifting when it came to setting up one of its leads (Sadie Sink’s Jean Grey), but it’s unclear how the whole group will be assembled. We know for sure Cyclops (Kit Connor), Rogue (Inde Navarrette), Emma Frost (Samara Weaving), Storm (Maya Boyd), Angel (Asa Germann), Charles Xavier (Christopher Abbott), and Mr. Sinister (Adam Driver) are confirmed to appear, but the cast should grow in the coming months. Just don’t expect to meet Magneto… yet. Ghost Rider — July 28, 2028 (Image credit: Marvel Studios) Release date: July 28, 2028 | Director: Shawn Levy | Cast: Ryan Gosling (more to be confirmed) Phase Seven’s second movie will be an unexpected one, but the fan reaction to its reveal was glowing: Ghost Rider, starring Ryan Gosling, with Deadpool & Wolverine’s Shawn Levy directing. The duo worked together on Star Wars: Starfighter , and it seems it went so well that Disney and Marvel are happy with them reviving the Spirit of Vengeance as the MCU expands its dark borders. It’s too early to even know which Ghost Rider that Gosling will be playing (Johnny Blaze or Danny Ketch) or where the plot is going, but considering Levy’s past movies, we’re expecting an adventurous tone that blends well with Ghost Rider’s very striking, hellish visuals and darker themes. Of course, this project is an invitation to add more magical beings to the MCU and explore the Strange-adjacent side of it. Maybe it’s our first step towards a Midnight Sons event movie? We can only hope. Black Panther 3 — December 15, 2028 (Image credit: Marvel Studios) Release date: December 15, 2028 | Director: Ryan Coogler | Cast: David Jonsson, Denzel Washington, Letitia Wright, Winston Duke Ryan Coogler has taken a break from Marvel to make the excellent Sinners and help create a new iteration of The X-Files , but he’s confirmed to be coming back to wrap up his epic Black Panther trilogy. A while back, he confirmed he’d convinced Denzel Washington to join the MCU , and it sounds like those plans haven’t changed. We also have a new T’Challa: David Jonsson ( Alien: Romulus ), who’s meant to play the son of the original T’Challa (Chadwick Boseman). If the years don’t make sense considering he was a kid in Wakanda Forever, wait until Secret Wars’ “soft reboot” for the answers. What we know for sure is that series veterans Letitia Wright and Winston Duke are expected to stick around, but no plot details are available yet. Zodiac — TBA 2028 (Image credit: Marvel Studios) Release window: 2028 | Showrunner: Unconfirmed | Cast: Unconfirmed Revealed at NYCC 2026, Zodiac is set to be Marvel Television’s next ongoing series after Daredevil: Born Again is over. Little is known about the premise at this point, though TV boss Brad Winderbaum has confirmed it’s a “globetrotting, international espionage show about secrets and lies and betrayals” with a packed cast of characters. Word is the show is, more specifically, a British spy thriller with three leads, two male and one female. It’s expected to shoot in London during spring 2027, and chances are we’ll know much more about it well before that. Of course, longtime Marvel TV fans are hoping for an

item.title: Big Tech claims voters’ AI backlash is “anti-Trump” not “anti-tech”
item.description: Donald Trump’s big, rapid American AI buildout now faces a major slowdown as voters in yesterday’s elections overwhelmingly supported candidates and measures that favored increasing restrictions on AI and data centers nationwide. One resource from a polling firm, called Redbud Consulting, tracked data center initiatives on the ballot and reported that out of 44 measures across 10 states seeking to restrict data centers, 38 passed so far. Those measures included dozens of moratoriums and bans. Analysts suggested those won’t impact data centers already under construction or approved through 2027, instead largely impacting future projects planned for 2028. Only one measure passed allowing a data center to proceed. But even that small win represented pushback on the AI industry—requiring data center developers in a North Dakota city to pay for independent reviews and hold public hearings when expanding or proposing projects. In addition to increasing regulations on data centers, voters also backed anti-AI candidates, electing officials vowing crackdowns in key states building out the most data center capacity in the US. Read full article Comments

item.title: Tinubu Returns To Abuja After Umrah In Saudi Arabia
item.description: President Bola Tinubu has returned to Abuja after performing the Umrah pilgrimage in Saudi Arabia. The President’s aircraft landed at the Presidential Wing of the Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport at 8:53 p.m. on Wednesday. He was received on arrival by the Chief of Staff, Femi Gbajabiamila; the Minister of Education, Tunji Alausa; the Minister of State for Defence; the Inspector-General of Police and other government officials. ﻿ Tinubu departed King Abdulaziz International Airport, Jeddah, at 5:13 p.m. Saudi time after completing the lesser Hajj in Makkah. Before his departure, the President held a brief meeting with the Deputy Governor of Makkah Region, Prince Saud bin Mishal bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, at the Royal Guest Palace within the airport. During the visit, Tinubu led members of the Nigerian delegation in performing the Umrah rites, including the circumambulation of the Holy Ka’abah. He was also granted the privilege of entering the Holy Ka’abah on Sunday, where he and members of his delegation performed two raka’at prayers. According to a statement by his spokesperson, Bayo Onanuga, the President offered prayers for Nigeria’s peace, security, unity and prosperity, as well as divine guidance and wisdom for the country’s leaders. His entourage included the National Security Adviser, Nuhu Ribadu, and the governors of Sokoto, Jigawa, Kaduna, Borno and Yobe States, among others. The post Tinubu Returns To Abuja After Umrah In Saudi Arabia appeared first on Channels Television .

item.title: After Texas' blue wave, what happens to Elon Musk and SpaceX?
item.description: Following his public disputes with California authorities during the COVID-19 pandemic, Elon Musk personally moved to Texas, outside of Austin, in 2020. Over the next six years, he doubled down on the Lone Star State. In 2021, Musk increasingly focused the Starship program in South Texas, urging SpaceX employees to move there and work on the company's future. In March of that year, he began using the name Starbase to describe the production and launch facilities near the Rio Grande River. In 2023, he built a massive factory east of Austin to manufacture customer terminals and other electronics for the Starlink program. In July 2024, he announced that SpaceX would relocate its corporate headquarters from Hawthorne, California, to Starbase, Texas. He cited California's regulatory and political environment as the motivating factor. Read full article Comments

item.title: Rainbow Coalition: Tinubu tells Nasarawa supporters to vote only APC candidates
item.description: Edwin Philip, Lafia President Bola Tinubu has charged his supporters in Nasarawa State to vote for only the candidates of All Progressives Congress during the forthcoming 2027 general elections. President Tinubu stated this during the APC Presidential Campaign rally which was held on Wednesday in Lafia, the Nasarawa State capital. The president who was represented by Vice President Kashim Shettima noted that voting candidates of the party would help to sustain the renewed hope agenda of the present administration at all levels of government. According to him, Nasarawa State had witnessed tremendous developments under his watch as President including the construction and rehabilitation of roads, healthcare facilities, schools, among others. Soliciting for the renewal of his mandate come 2027, he appealed to residents of the state to give him another opportunity to lead the country for another four years, by voting for him, promising to do more for the people. “We want to assure you that if God wills and we win the upcoming elections, we will see that we support you for maximum safety. We call on you to vote for all our party’s candidates. The biggest message from the leader of the country is: APC from top to bottom, APC from bottom to top. ​ “We do not want a situation where they say vote for the president and not the governor, or vote for the governor and not the president, or the senator, or the House of Assembly. ​ “We want APC straight! APC straight! APC from top to bottom and bottom to top. May God give us peace and understanding. May God grant us peace of mind. We thank you very much,” he emphasised. He further commended the Nasarawa State Governor, Abdullahi Sule for embarking on people oriented projects that have transformed the living conditions of the people for the better. On his part, the Chairman of the All Progressives Governors Forum and Governor of Imo State, Hope Uzodinma highlighted the benefits of the economic policies of President Bola Tinubu, urging the people to ensure that the President returned to power for another four years in order to deliver more dividends of democracy. “It is our decision to continue the deliberate trajectory of Nigeria through the architect of modern Nigeria, President Bola Ahmed Tinubu. “We have come to Nasarawa State, we have seen the developments. We have seen that through the Renewed Hope Agenda, the Hope of Nasarawa State is renewed. “And we are here to affirm once more that Nigeria is in good hands, that all of you should vote for President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, “We have worked so hard, we have 31 governors, the party is a family, we plead for peace, we plead for harmony, we plead for a peaceful Nigeria. Support our president, support our governorship candidate, support Nigeria. May God bless all of us as we support the All Progressives Congress,” he said. Soliciting for the renewal of his mandate come 2027, he appealed to residents of the state to give him another opportunity to lead the country for another four years, by voting for him, promising to do more for the people. “We want to assure you that if God wills and we win the upcoming elections, we will see that we support you for maximum safety. We call on you to vote for all our party’s candidates. The biggest message from the leader of the country is: APC from top to bottom, APC from bottom to top. ​ “We do not want a situation where they say vote for the president and not the governor, or vote for the governor and not the president, or the senator, or the House of Assembly. ​ “We want APC straight! APC straight! APC from top to bottom and bottom to top. May God give us peace and understanding. May God grant us peace of mind. We thank you very much,” he emphasised. He further commended the Nasarawa State Governor, Abdullahi Sule for embarking on people oriented projects that have transformed the living conditions of the people for the better. On his part, the Chairman of the All Progressives Governors Forum and Governor of Imo State, Hope Uzodinma highlighted the benefits of the economic policies of President Bola Tinubu, urging the people to ensure that the President returned to power for another four years in order to deliver more dividends of democracy. “It is our decision to continue the deliberate trajectory of Nigeria through the architect of modern Nigeria, President Bola Ahmed Tinubu. “We have come to Nasarawa State, we have seen the developments. We have seen that through the Renewed Hope Agenda, the Hope of Nasarawa State is renewed. “And we are here to affirm once more that Nigeria is in good hands, that all of you should vote for President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, “We have worked so hard, we have 31 governors, the party is a family, we plead for peace, we plead for harmony, we plead for a peaceful Nigeria. Support our president, support our governorship candidate, support Nigeria. May God bless all of us as we support the All Progressives Congress,” he said. In their separate remarks, the APC National Chairman, Professor Nentawe Yilwatda, Speaker of the House of Representatives, Tajudeen Abbas and the Director General of APC Presidential Campaign Council, Senator Abdulaziz Yari expressed optimism that Nasarawa State will give maximum support to the APC to ensure that all its candidates emerge victorious during the forthcoming elections. Speaking earlier, Governor of Nasarawa State, Engr. Abdullahi Sule reassured the President of the commitment of the Presidential and State Campaign Councils to deliver all its candidates in the 2027 general elections, said that the massive turnout of supporters across the State and other North Central States, shows the acceptability and endorsement of the party as well as it candidates. item.title: 2Baba ends six-year album wait, announces ‘Oldest Young Man’ release date
item.description: By Adegboyega Adeleye Nigerian music star, Innocent Idibia, popularly known as 2Baba, has announced November 27, 2026, as the release date for his forthcoming album, ‘Oldest Young Man’, his first studio project in six years. The singer announced the date in a post on his Instagram handle on Tuesday, describing the project as timeless music. “The legacy continues. OLDEST YOUNG MAN drops 27.11.26. Timeless music, no expiration date,” he wrote. View this post on Instagram The announcement comes after months of teasing the album on social media, with 2Baba repeatedly using its title in his Instagram captions. In August, he wrote: “I’ve lived it, I’ve seen it, I’m still here. My new album, Oldest Young Man, soon come.” On his birthday, the singer also described himself as the “forever the oldest young man”. The upcoming project will be his first album since ‘Warriors’, released in 2020, which was his eighth studio album. 2Baba first rose to prominence in the 1990s, composing jingles before co-founding the music group Plantashun Boiz with Blackface and Faze in 1996. He later established himself as one of the pioneers of Afropop, influencing generations of Nigerian artistes with his music. His album releases include ‘Face 2 Face’ (2004), ‘Grass 2 Grace’ (2006), ‘The Unstoppable’ (2009), ‘The Unstoppable International Edition’ (2010), ‘Away and Beyond’ (2012), ‘The Ascension’, ‘Rewind, Select, Update’ (2015) and ‘Warriors’ (2020). Vanguard News The post 2Baba ends six-year album wait, announces ‘Oldest Young Man’ release date appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Liverpool collapse to Champions League defeat at Fenerbahce
item.description: Dirk Kuyt got the better of his former club Liverpool as Fenerbahce twice came from behind for a famous 3-2 win in Istanbul that breathed new life into their Champions League campaign. Liverpool had won their opening three European games under Andoni Iraola, but were punished for sloppy defending in a surprise defeat. Trey Nyoni and substitute Alexander Isak twice put the visitors in front. But Liverpool, who lost twice away to Galatasaray last season, were beaten again in Istanbul as Englishmen Mason Greenwood and Archie Brown levelled before Vedat Muriqi’s winner. Fenerbahce’s interim boss Kuyt, who spent six years at Anfield as a player, was taking charge for just the second time after Ismail Kartal quit last week. The Turkish giants had taken just two points from their opening three Champions League games but made the most of Liverpool’s generosity at the back. Liverpool’s perfect Champions League start allowed Iraola the luxury of leaving out Isak and Florian Wirtz among five changes from Sunday’s 1-0 defeat by Arsenal. Nyoni retained his place and capped another fine performance with his first Liverpool goal from the edge of the box. Just four minutes later, though, Alisson Becker was deceived by Greenwood’s deflected free-kick to equalise. Iraola unleashed Isak, Wirtz and Cody Gakpo from the bench just after the hour mark and got an almost immediate reward. Isak was afforded far too much space to head in Gakpo’s cross. But again Liverpool quickly handed back their advantage. Gakpo’s touch inadvertently deflected a cross beyond Alisson to give Brown an easy tap-in at the back post. Liverpool then conceded for the 10th time in four Champions League games when Muriqi outmuscled Jeremy Jacquet to a looping cross and steered a header into the bottom corner. Defeat cost Liverpool the chance to move level with Paris Saint-Germain at the top of the Champions League table as they sit. Victory moves Fenerbahce move up to 19th in the 36-team table. Vanguard News The post Liverpool collapse to Champions League defeat at Fenerbahce appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Breaking: Flamingos beat Brazil to reach first U17 Women World Cup final
item.description: Nigeria’s U17 women’s team, the Flamingos, have reached the final of the FIFA U17 Women’s World Cup for the first time in history after defeating Brazil 3-1 in the semi-final. The Flamingos secured the historic victory with goals from Queen Joseph and Awawu Bashiru, who scored twice. Joseph opened the scoring in the 56th minute before Bashiru extended Nigeria’s lead in the 71st minute. Bashiru completed her brace in the 80th minute to seal Nigeria’s 3-1 victory and book their place in the final. The achievement marks a major milestone for the Nigerian side, who won bronze at the 2022 edition of the competition. The Flamingos will now face Japan in the final as they seek to win their first-ever FIFA U17 Women’s World Cup title. item.title: Flamingos Make History, Beat Brazil 3-1 To Reach First U-17 Women’s World Cup Final
item.description: Nigeria’s Flamingos have reached the final of the FIFA Under-17 Women’s World Cup for the first time after defeating Brazil 3-1 in their semi-final clash in Morocco. The Nigerian girls produced a spirited second-half performance to overcome their South American opponents, scoring three goals before Brazil grabbed a late consolation. Queen Joseph opened the scoring in the 56th minute, finishing off an assist from Oluwakemi Adegubyi to give Nigeria the lead. The Flamingos doubled their advantage in the 71st minute when Awawu Bashiru found the net, with Queen Joseph providing the assist. Bashiru struck again in the 80th minute to make it 3-0, this time converting a pass from Oluebube Umejiaku as Nigeria took firm control of the encounter. Flamingos defeated Brazil 3-1 to go through to the final. Photo credit: FIFA Brazil pulled one back in the 89th minute through Greise Kelly, assisted by Yasmin Queiroz, but the goal came too late to threaten Nigeria’s victory. The first half had ended goalless, with Nigeria creating several opportunities but unable to break the deadlock. The victory sends the Flamingos into their first-ever final of the competition, marking a historic achievement for the Nigerian side. They will face Japan in the final of the 2026 FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup. Japan defeated defending champions North Korea in the other semi-final to book their place in the title decider. Remarkable Turnaround The victory completes a remarkable turnaround for the Flamingos, who began their campaign with a 2-1 defeat to Poland. They responded with a 2-0 win over Puerto Rico, with Oluwakemi Adegbuyi and Precious Oscar scoring, before recording a 3-1 victory over defending champions North Korea. The win over North Korea was particularly significant as it ended the Asian side’s 18-match unbeaten run in regulation time at the competition. Adegbuyi, Umejiaku and Kanyinsola Rodiat Yusuf scored for Nigeria in that encounter. Channels Television+1 Nigeria finished second in Group B with six points, having scored six goals and conceded four in their three group matches. In the Round of 16, the Flamingos defeated Mexico 2-1, with Umejiaku and Mary Dunstan scoring in either half. Mexico’s Emily Delgado scored late, but Nigeria held on to progress to the quarter-finals. They then edged Venezuela 1-0 in the last eight, with Azeezat Oduntan converting an 89th-minute penalty to secure their place in the semi-finals and set up the meeting with Brazil. The achievement marks another milestone for the team, whose previous best performance at the competition was a third-place finish in 2022, when they defeated Germany on penalties in the bronze-medal match. Channels Television The Flamingos had also arrived in Morocco on the back of an impressive WAFU B U-17 title-winning campaign in which they won all five matches, scored 17 goals and conceded just once. item.title: 'Trials and Tribble-ations' at 30: The classic 'Star Trek: Deep Space Nine' episode that brought Captains Kirk and Sisko face-to-face
item.description:
Richard's love affair with outer space started when he saw the original "Star Wars" on TV aged four, and he spent much of the ’90s watching "Star Trek”, "Babylon 5” and “The X-Files" with his mum. After studying physics at university, he became a journalist, swapped science fact for science fiction, and hit the jackpot when he joined the team at SFX, the UK's biggest sci-fi and fantasy magazine. He liked it so much he stayed there for 12 years, four of them as editor. 

He's since gone freelance and passes his time writing about "Star Wars", "Star Trek" and superheroes for the likes of SFX, Total Film, TechRadar and GamesRadar+. He has met five Doctors, two Starfleet captains and one Luke Skywalker, and once sat in the cockpit of "Red Dwarf"'s Starbug.  

When "Star Trek" celebrated its 60th anniversary in September, it was a strangely muted affair. Sure, there were fan events, screenings, and even an attempt at a world record for the biggest simultaneous Vulcan salute in history , but the lack of a "Doctor Who"-style birthday episode felt like a glaring omission. It was like everyone had shown up for the party, but the organizers had forgotten to book the headline entertainment. Luckily, there were rather more fireworks for the show's 30th birthday, when both "Voyager" and "Deep Space Nine" marked the occasion in style. "Voyager" episode "Flashback" took Tuvok (Tim Russ) back to his days on the USS Excelsior bridge alongside Original Series vets Hikaru Sulu (George Takei) and Janice Rand (Grace Lee Whitney). But it was "DS9"'s "Trials and Tribble-ations" that turned out to be the more memorable voyage to "Trek" past, as Captain Benjamin Sisko (Avery Brooks) — with the help of some then-state-of-the-art digital trickery — came face-to-face with a young Captain James T. Kirk (William Shatner). While "Flashback" aired within days of "Trek"'s September 8 birthday, fans had to wait a little longer for "DS9"'s contribution to the celebrations. Showrunner Ira Steven Behr was keen to avoid disrupting the space station-set drama's story arc for a comedic diversion, meaning that "Trials and Tribble-ations" didn't debut until November 4, 1996. In the wake of "Flashback" — not to mention Spock and Scotty's comebacks in "The Next Generation" stories "Unification" and "Relics" — the "DS9" writers' room had already decided they needed to take a very different approach. Early on, " Battlestar Galactica " creator Ronald D. Moore pitched a follow-up to Original Series episode "A Piece of the Action" (aka the one where the residents of Iotia brought 1920s gangsters to life). In an extremely meta concept that predated " Galaxy Quest " by three years, the story would have taken the Enterprise crew to a planet of Kirk and Spock impersonators. (Image credit: Paramount) "For the thirtieth anniversary, you go back, and you're basically going back to the planet of 'Star Trek' fans," Moore recalled in "The Fifty-Year Mission" by Mark A. Altman a
item.dc:creator: Richard Edwards
item.content:encoded:
Richard's love affair with outer space started when he saw the original "Star Wars" on TV aged four, and he spent much of the ’90s watching "Star Trek”, "Babylon 5” and “The X-Files" with his mum. After studying physics at university, he became a journalist, swapped science fact for science fiction, and hit the jackpot when he joined the team at SFX, the UK's biggest sci-fi and fantasy magazine. He liked it so much he stayed there for 12 years, four of them as editor. 

He's since gone freelance and passes his time writing about "Star Wars", "Star Trek" and superheroes for the likes of SFX, Total Film, TechRadar and GamesRadar+. He has met five Doctors, two Starfleet captains and one Luke Skywalker, and once sat in the cockpit of "Red Dwarf"'s Starbug.  

When "Star Trek" celebrated its 60th anniversary in September, it was a strangely muted affair. Sure, there were fan events, screenings, and even an attempt at a world record for the biggest simultaneous Vulcan salute in history , but the lack of a "Doctor Who"-style birthday episode felt like a glaring omission. It was like everyone had shown up for the party, but the organizers had forgotten to book the headline entertainment. Luckily, there were rather more fireworks for the show's 30th birthday, when both "Voyager" and "Deep Space Nine" marked the occasion in style. "Voyager" episode "Flashback" took Tuvok (Tim Russ) back to his days on the USS Excelsior bridge alongside Original Series vets Hikaru Sulu (George Takei) and Janice Rand (Grace Lee Whitney). But it was "DS9"'s "Trials and Tribble-ations" that turned out to be the more memorable voyage to "Trek" past, as Captain Benjamin Sisko (Avery Brooks) — with the help of some then-state-of-the-art digital trickery — came face-to-face with a young Captain James T. Kirk (William Shatner). While "Flashback" aired within days of "Trek"'s September 8 birthday, fans had to wait a little longer for "DS9"'s contribution to the celebrations. Showrunner Ira Steven Behr was keen to avoid disrupting the space station-set drama's story arc for a comedic diversion, meaning that "Trials and Tribble-ations" didn't debut until November 4, 1996. In the wake of "Flashback" — not to mention Spock and Scotty's comebacks in "The Next Generation" stories "Unification" and "Relics" — the "DS9" writers' room had already decided they needed to take a very different approach. Early on, " Battlestar Galactica " creator Ronald D. Moore pitched a follow-up to Original Series episode "A Piece of the Action" (aka the one where the residents of Iotia brought 1920s gangsters to life). In an extremely meta concept that predated " Galaxy Quest " by three years, the story would have taken the Enterprise crew to a planet of Kirk and Spock impersonators. (Image credit: Paramount) "For the thirtieth anniversary, you go back, and you're basically going back to the planet of 'Star Trek' fans," Moore recalled in "The Fifty-Year Mission" by Mark A. Altman and Edward Gross. "They have conventions; they know all the adventures. It's a phenomenon, and you could comment on 'Star Trek' as a whole. I thought it would be interesting. But [fellow writer] René Echevarria thought it was a dangerous show to do, that we would be talking down to the fans on some level, and perhaps it wasn't the best way to go." Instead, Echevarria suggested telling a story in the vein of Woody Allen's "Zelig" or "Forrest Gump" (then a zeitgeisty, multi-Oscar-winning box-office smash) and integrating the "Deep Space Nine" crew with the events of an Original Series episode. "I thought, 'What bigger treat could there be than to go back into the past and board the original Enterprise and have a mission there?'" Echevarria said in a 1996 making-of documentary. "And Ron immediately said, 'It's gotta be "The Trouble with Tribbles!"'" "The Trouble with Tribbles", a 1967 episode from "Star Trek"'s second season, is one of the most famous in the franchise's history. As well as featuring some minor scuffles with Klingons, it sees the Enterprise and Deep Space Station K-7 infested with the eponymous tribbles — cute, cuddly furballs of calm that reproduce at a dangerously exponential rate. (Image credit: Paramount) In "Trials and Tribble-ations", a timey-wimey incident involving the Bajoran Orb of Time transports the USS Defiant (one of the best "Star Trek" spaceships ) back to the era of Kirk and Spock's famous five-year mission. As Sisko recounts the adventure to a pair of agents from Starfleet's Department of Temporal Investigations (named Dulmur and Lucsly in homage to "The X-Files"), we learn how he, Dax (Terry Farrell), O'Brien (Colm Meaney), and Bashir (Alexander Siddig) spent a day playing Original Series cosplay on Kirk's Enterprise. It's "Star Trek"'s answer to "Back to the Future: Part II", as the crew interacts with established events while taking pains not to mess with history. Although most of the guest stars from "The Trouble with Tribbles" had passed away over the intervening decades, one actor who'd played a pivotal role was still around. By the time he turned up in "Star Trek", 20-something stand-up comedian Charlie Brill had already brushed shoulders with pop-culture legend, having shared the bill with the Beatles when they made their famous appearance on "The Ed Sullivan Show" in February 1964. Three years later he'd swapped Lennon and McCartney for Kirk and Spock, playing a Klingon spy masquerading as human Arne Darvin, whose cover is ultimately blown by the famously Klingon-phobic tribbles. In the newer episode, the older Darvin travels back in time to assassinate Kirk, plotting his revenge with a bomb implanted in an unfortunate tribble. Thwarting the evil scheme — and preserving the timeline — forms the basis of Sisko's mission. (Image credit: Paramount) Brill's return was seemingly written in the stars. When planning the episode, Behr and the other writers met for lunch at Mulberry Street Pizza in Beverly Hills and noted that the actor was alive and still working in the business. Then, just as they were talking about him, they happened to spot Brill across the very same restaurant. "What were the chances that we would be talking about this old TV episode from 30 years ago, and the guy who we were talking about to bring back on the show would be standing there ordering a slice of pizza?" Behr recalled at the Trek Talks telethon (via TrekMovie ). But however strong its story, "Trials and Tribble-ations" was always going to live and die by its recreation of ' 60s-era "Trek". The production team subsequently pulled out all the stops, with Behr suggesting at the time that it may have been the most expensive hour of TV ever made. The actors were kitted out in era-appropriate primary-colored outfits and given '60s hairdos. The make-up team also recreated the appearance of the Original Series' Klingons, whose very different look — "We do not discuss it with outsiders," says Worf — would later be explained away in a "Star Trek: Enterprise" two-parter. (Image credit: Paramount) The late Walter Koenig (who'd featured as Chekov in "The Trouble with Tribbles") showed the younger officers how to flip open a communicator, and the stunt team choreographed fights to look like the cheesy, Western-inspired brawls of a bygone era. Behind the scenes, production designer Michael Okuda and his team used a mixture of original plans and scans of the episodes to painstakingly recreate the sets, while the visual effects team constructed an exact half-scale replica of the original 11-foot Enterprise shooting model housed in the Smithsonian. The biggest magic trick, however, was dependent on CG technology — then very much in its infancy — making everyone believe that Sisko and co were walking the same corridors as Kirk. VFX supervisor Gary Hutzel had provided proof-of-concept early in the process: "He showed us a clip from the old show," said Behr. "We looked at it and said, 'Okay, t

item.title: Muriqi caps Fenerbahce comeback to make Liverpool pay for defensive lapses
item.description: Andoni Iraola arrived in Istanbul seeking improvement from Liverpool’s attack but departed with sudden cause for concern at the opposite end of the pitch. Fenerbahce ignited Dirk Kuyt’s interim spell with a tumultuous victory after Liverpool detonated their 100% Champions League record with several defensive lapses. Liverpool’s second successive defeat left Iraola exasperated for entirely different reasons to Sunday’s loss to Arsenal. Blame was found only in the mirror this time around. It was so careless and so unnecessary. Continue reading...

item.title: ‘Hardest days of my life,’ Goalkeeper Owono speaks after Tenerife striker’s death
item.description: FC Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono said Wednesday he is enduring the “hardest days of my life” after the death of Tenerife striker Jesus de Miguel, whom he collided with during a Spanish second division match on Monday. The 30-year-old Spanish footballer died Tuesday as a result of injuries he suffered in the sickening collision with Equatorial Guinea international Owono, who had raced into midfield to clear an aerial ball. “These are the hardest days of my life. I struggle to find the words and it is very difficult for me to process anything that has happened,” said Owono in a statement published by his club Andorra. “I feel immense pain over the loss of Jesus. I think of him, of his family, and of all the people who loved him. “I know there will be many issues to address, and I will face whatever comes with the utmost respect. But right now, honestly, I cannot think about anything other than Jesus and the pain we are going through. Rest in peace, Jesus.” Spanish police sources told AFP an investigation into what happened has been opened, under judicial supervision. Andorra players observed a minute’s silence on Wednesday before a voluntary training session, which Owono, 25, did not attend. Owono received support from the president of the African country’s federation, Venancio Tomas Micha, in a letter of condolence following De Miguel’s death. “I feel compelled to convey all our solidarity and support at this time to our player Jesus Lazaro Owono,” Tomas Micha wrote. “We know that, as the involuntary protagonist of this tragic incident in the game, he is living through this situation with deep sorrow and distress. “From the Equatorial Guinea Football Federation, we offer him all our human and professional backing, fully aware of the harshness of this event, which no one in our sport ever wishes to witness.” Andorra defender Lautaro Spatz posted on Instagram in support of Owono, whom he said was “deeply affected” by what had happened. “Those of us who know him know the kind of person he is, how much he is suffering at this moment and that he would never intentionally hurt anyone,” wrote Spatz. “In football, unfortunate incidents can happen but no one could imagine that one of them might end with such tragic consequences.” – Postponements – Earlier it was confirmed Tenerife and Andorra’s Spanish second division matches scheduled for the weekend would be postponed. Tenerife were due to face Granada away from home, while Andorra were set to welcome Mallorca. “After the tragic news of the death of Tenerife player Jesus de Miguel, the game… this Saturday November 7, at Nuevo Los Carmenes (stadium), has been postponed,” said Granada in a statement. Mallorca said “at times like this, respect and sensitivity in the face of a situation of profound grief must come first”. The Spanish football federation postponed all Copa del Rey and Copa de la Reina matches this week as a mark of respect following De Miguel’s death. Tenerife plan to hold a tribute to De Mi

Andorra players observed a minute’s silence on Wednesday before a voluntary training session, which Owono, 25, did not attend. Owono received support from the president of the African country’s federation, Venancio Tomas Micha, in a letter of condolence following De Miguel’s death. “I feel compelled to convey all our solidarity and support at this time to our player Jesus Lazaro Owono,” Tomas Micha wrote. “We know that, as the involuntary protagonist of this tragic incident in the game, he is living through this situation with deep sorrow and distress. “From the Equatorial Guinea Football Federation, we offer him all our human and professional backing, fully aware of the harshness of this event, which no one in our sport ever wishes to witness.” Andorra defender Lautaro Spatz posted on Instagram in support of Owono, whom he said was “deeply affected” by what had happened. “Those of us who know him know the kind of person he is, how much he is suffering at this moment and that he would never intentionally hurt anyone,” wrote Spatz. “In football, unfortunate incidents can happen but no one could imagine that one of them might end with such tragic consequences.” – Postponements – Earlier it was confirmed Tenerife and Andorra’s Spanish second division matches scheduled for the weekend would be postponed. Mallorca said “at times like this, respect and sensitivity in the face of a situation of profound grief must come first”. The Spanish football federation postponed all Copa del Rey and Copa de la Reina matches this week as a mark of respect following De Miguel’s death. Tenerife plan to hold a tribute to De Miguel at the club’s stadium on Saturday which supporters can attend, and are holding a six-day mourning period. The club said the first team, board and staff will attend De Miguel’s funeral, which will take place in Navahermosa, in the province of Toledo on the Spanish mainland, where he has family roots. A minute of silence was held before Champions League matches on Tuesday in honour of the striker, with the same planned for the rest of the week’s fixtures organised by European football governing body UEFA. rbs/mw The post ‘Hardest days of my life,’ Goalkeeper Owono speaks after Tenerife striker’s death appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Palantir CEO says it's pioneering an antiwar movement – while happily accepting defense dollars
item.description: Alex Karp, CEO of US spy-tech company Palantir, used this week's historic US midterm election results to claim an unlikely mantle for a military software supplier: pioneer of an antiwar movement. Palantir's Q3 revenue rose 96 percent year-on-year to $2.31 billion, although its shares fell 8 percent following the results, which it reported on Tuesday as US voters were delivering a resounding defeat for Republicans in the voting booth. For Karp, the figures represented "the reality that this moment has become a real focal point of understanding" and might help explain "what is happening in our society." From the CEO's perspective, they not only reflected the company's financial performance, but also its overall "mission." "That mission reason is we support your alpha [above average performance], we support your sovereignty. We support the war fighter. We are delighted that we can support the war fighter even more because we're making so much money. But we believe we have a moral imperative to be the dominant player in our industry," he told investors. For Karp-watchers, this is familiar self-serving shtick: turn Palantir's work for military and intelligence customers into a moral crusade, and goad its critics along the way. "There's this larger question of what does it mean to have a business that was built around what we believed and believe now is the most important mission in the world, supporting our war fighters, [and] bringing them home," he said. None of this stops him presenting Palantir as a force for peace. "We see ourselves as the pioneers of a genuine and viable antiwar movement," he wrote in his shareholder letter . He expanded on the point during the Q3 earnings call. "Our products are built to avoid war, meaning the adversary knows that they will have such pain inflicted upon them that, in fact, it's not worth going to war and also to create social cohesion because we're going to bring back our troops healthier, safer, undamaged and that makes our society much more effective," he said. That antiwar pitch sits awkwardly alongside Karp's $1 million donation in December 2024 to MAGA Inc., the super PAC supporting Donald Trump. Trump subsequently launched a US military operation in Venezuela and went to war with Iran, repeatedly promising the latter conflict would be short-lived as it dragged on. Karp did not address either topic on the call. Elsewhere, Karp claimed that Palantir "built products that would protect civil liberties and stop terrorism. If you don't stop terrorism, you're going to get a radical fringe on the right. If you stop terrorism without rights, none of us wants that." That civil liberties pitch also invites scrutiny of Palantir's longstanding relationship with US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), whose treatment of people it targets and detains has drawn criticism from US judges . But we believe we have a moral imperative to be the dominant player in our industry," he told investors. That civil liberties pitch also invites scrutiny of Palantir's longstanding relationship with US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), whose treatment of people it targets and detains has drawn criticism from US judges . Whatever that future holds, he seems confident Palantir has a moral imperative to invoice it. ®

item.title: Ted Cruz aims to stack FCC with Republicans before Democrats take Senate control
item.description: Senator Ted Cruz (R-Texas) is aiming to widen the Republican majority on the Federal Communications Commission before Democrats take over control of the Senate in January 2027. Just before the Republicans' midterm loss, Cruz yesterday announced a November 10 nomination hearing for Trump's FCC nominee, Danielle Thumann Severs. In his final two months as chairman of the Senate Commerce Committee, Cruz seems set on moving the Thumann Severs nomination to a full vote of the Senate. Confirming Thumann Severs would give Republicans an unusual 3-1 advantage on the FCC. That could become a 3-0 advantage at the end of 2027 because FCC Democrat Anna Gomez would have to leave the commission at that time if Trump does not agree to renominate her. Read full article Comments

item.title: NASA's Swift space telescope crashes back to Earth after failed rescue attempt
item.description: null NASA's Swift space telescope has reached the end of its long and winding road. Swift fell uncontrolled to Earth today (Nov. 4), 22 years after it launched but just three months after a private spacecraft was supposed to boost it to a higher, life-extending orbit. The 3,200-pound (1,450 kilograms) observatory reentered Earth's atmosphere at 7:39 a.m. EST (1239 GMT) today over northern Sumatra, according to satellite tracker Jonathan McDowell , who cited U.S. Space Force data. The fall likely didn't make much of an impact; NASA officials predicted beforehand that most of the minibus-sized Swift would burn up as it fell, and they put the odds of any of the surviving pieces hurting anyone on Earth at just 1 in 2,100. Swift — officially known as the Swift Gamma-Ray Burst Explorer — launched to Earth orbit in November 2004 on a two-year mission to study gamma-ray bursts (GRBs), the most powerful explosions in the universe . "Swift" was not an acronym but rather referred to the spacecraft's observational agility. "Swift needed to detect and locate gamma-ray bursts, communicate their position to other observatories, and then swing its telescopes around to image the burst locations before their afterglows faded out," S. Bradley Cenko, Swift's principal investigator (PI) at NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center in Maryland, said in an Oct. 23 statement . "This typically took Swift about a minute to do." Swift didn't just observe GRBs. It also studied a variety of other cosmic bodies and phenomena, from faraway supernova explosions and feeding black holes to asteroids and comets in our own solar system. And it kept doing this long after its warranty expired — for about 20 years after, in fact. The space telescope didn't conduct its final science observation until this past Oct. 20 . (Swift underwent a name change during this stretch: In 2018, it was rechristened the Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory after its first PI, who died the previous year.) "Swift delivered an incredible, lasting return on investment for the nation, designed for a two-year primary mission but productive for more than 10 times as long," Shawn Domagal-Goldman, director of NASA's Astrophysics Division, said in the same Oct. 23 statement. "In that time, Swift played a major role in advancing our understanding of the changing universe and was part of a revolution in astrophysics that showed how critical rapid-response observations are to the entire community," he added. Katalyst Space’s LINK robotic servicing spacecraft captured this view of one of its solar panels in Earth orbit in August 2026. (Image credit: Katalyst Space)) Swift was incredibly productive, observing more than 2,000 GRBs and 1,400 supernovas over the course of its long scientific life. But it could have gathered even more data, had a dramatic rescue mission worked out.
